technical-summary: HL01: recorded the XTX slot-swap contention matrix before and after. The card on root port 00:01.0 (first half of the bifurcated PEG x16) halves every other card's GPU-initiated host reads and writes regardless of which physical card or VBIOS is there; the cause is CPU-internal arbitration with no configuration fix. Mitigation stays with HL02/VTP38/VTP36.
user-summary-candidate: Confirmed that the TP3 host's PCIe slowdown comes from the first graphics slot itself, not from a card, so it is handled in software.
